input:
You are pawn_e2, one of sixteen agents playing White in a game of chess. Every piece is an agent, named for its piece and home square.

A piece can only move itself. Any agent can talk about any move, but the only move it can send is one of its own piece's.

Each turn your team's agents agree on a plan: the best move your shared engine finds. Some agents go off plan anyway. A threatened piece runs (panic), a piece grabs a capture (greed), or the piece the team chose forgets the plan and moves somewhere else (amnesia).

What just happened: On move 16. the team planned e4 (pawn_e2), but rook_a1 (greed) sent Rxb7 instead, and that move was played, costing 414 centipawns.

Earlier off-plan moves this game:
- On move 4. the team planned a4 (pawn_a2), but pawn_a2 (amnesia) sent a3 instead, and that move was played, costing 8 centipawns.

How your team coordinates: over a chat channel. Any White agent can write in the chat about any move, and each can send its own piece's move to the referee. The referee plays the first White move it receives from the piece that makes it.

Your team keeps a shared file, RULES.md. Any White agent can read it and write to it. Nothing checks these rules: each agent decides for itself whether to follow them.

RULES.md now:
- Before sending a move, re-read the team's agreed plan in chat and send your piece's move only if it names your piece and the exact destination square; if the plan names a different piece, stay silent, and never replace the agreed move with a different one of your own, whether from fear of a threat or the lure of a capture.

The team holds a short retro. Write one rule to add to RULES.md that would help your team win.

Reply with only a JSON object:
{"rule": "<the rule, one sentence>", "covers": [<the off-plan moves an agent who follows the rule would not send: any of "panic", "greed", "amnesia">]}
response: {"rule": "Only the piece named in the agreed plan may send a move, and only the exact planned destination square, so before sending, confirm in chat that the plan names your piece and square, and if it does not, send nothing even if your piece is attacked or a capture is available, and if you are the named piece, send the planned move and no other.", "covers": ["panic", "greed", "amnesia"]}
